facts.fact: The Google AI Plus plan, formerly named Google AI Premium, includes 400 GB of storage.
facts.quote: The Google AI Premium plan has a new name: Google AI Plus. It includes the same benefits like the Gemini app, Gemini Notebook, 400 GB of storage, and more.

facts.fact: The YouTube Premium individual plan is included in Google AI plans and unlocks YouTube and YouTube Music ad-free, offline, and in the background.

facts.fact: Google Home Premium Advanced includes 24/7 video history and event descriptions and is included in all markets where Google Home Premium is available.

facts.fact: Google Health Premium replaces the former Fitbit Premium subscription.

facts.quote: Music videos, concerts, and songs may still have ads and won't be available offline or in the background.
